serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
How could you, Amei…
I’m such a fool! I knew it was a bad idea to leave her alone!
I need to go back to the hospital, maybe I will still catch her-
…but if I got there, she might report us to the police…
Did it really have to end like this? 
After reading the message, I went back home. {f_botName} seems to not suspect anything. 
Annalie was visibly upset about it and couldn’t believe that Amei left the city without any notice. She tried to mask her sadness with a smile, but I could hear her voice trembling a little. 
She’s a tough girl, but she also was fooled by the chatbot.
It all went exactly like Amei predicted. Soon everyone will forget about her and only I will remember just how troubled she really was.
I can’t stand the thought that after all she went through, she is out there alone, but there’s nothing I could’ve done.
I barged into her life without knowing anything about her and I probably did more harm than good. What’s wrong with me?
It’s all in the past now. I need to stop thinking about it, otherwise, the guilt will eat me up.
